verse: śrībhairava uvāca devi tvaṃ parameśāni guhyaṃ guhyataraṃ śubham | pṛcchāmi parayā bhaktyā bāhyaṃ guhyamidaṃ param
ṣodaśaṃtaṃ vijānīyāt sarvakālaṃ mahāmate | sṛṣṭipañcamakaṃ yad vai saṃhārāt saptame yutam
na ca bindugataṃ nātha nānodayavivarjitam | na śūnyaṃ na cā śūnyaṃ vā śūnyānāṃ bhayavarjitam
tāsāṃ jñānaṃ yathā mantro  melāpaṃ tu mahāmate ||2/23 ||
aṣṭamena adhaḥkrāntaṃ caturdaśamasaṃyutam | sthitivarṇamavarṇena līlayā lāṃchitaṃ kuru
astināstipadairhīnā sthitirūpā krameṇa tu | antasthā bhūtasaṃghasya svarasya pararūpiṇī | arūḍharūḍhayormadhye uttarottaragarbhiṇī
śuddhabuddhepadaṃ brahmā nairūpyadharmavāhana | tatastū yamārahite saṃyojya vidhināhare
sṛṣṭisaptamakaṃ gṛhya saṃhārasyāṣṭame yutam | navamaṃ taṃ vijānīyad daśamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu
See chapter 15/59 of the Aajñākhaṇḍa śrīmadduttaradigbhāge pīṭhaṃ pīṭhavaraṃ mahat | oḍḍiyānābhidhānante siddhiyoginisevitam
vyomabhāvakalātīte avyakteśi namo'stu te | khaṇḍarūpapadātīte rūpānteśi namo'stu te
jñānopāsye mahājñāne jñeyarūpe namo'stu te | kriyārūpe mahārūpe viśvarūpe namo'stu te
sakṣunyetiḥ svabhāvākhye viśvagrāsā parā citiḥ | laharīṃ prathamāṃ viddhi śāṃbhavī kālabhakṣakī
kathitā parameśāna pūjanavidhiruttamā | śrībhairava ūvāca tvāṃ vidyā devadeveśi sthiticakrasya bhairavi
guptaṃ tu paramaṃ divyaṃ kimarthaṃ naravandite | etad vadasva me (?) vāme yathāvidhiranukramāt
kālāntare tu saṃprāpte vakṣyāmi tu yathā tathyam  ||1/ 53 ||
2/? mahāsthāneśabharitā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | amanā mānasairbhāvaiḥ hīnā manonnatā sadā
trikoṇasya sadā madhye pūjyā sṛṣṭistu sādhakaiḥ | si *? sha yathā nyāyaṃ yoginībhistathaiva ca
kā devyo devadeveśi ādau pūjyāḥ kramāgatāḥ | etat kathaya māṃ devi pāramparyakramāgatam
sthitirūpaṃ mahāntaṃ vai ṣoḍaśāraṃ tu viśvagam | tadbāhye tu paraṃ divyaṃ nāma datvā prayatnataḥ
haṭharāvā  arāvasthā rāveṇa haṭhabhakṣakī  ||2/28 ||
siddhijaṃ narakaṃ nīya mahārudhirapuritam | pūjayed dīrghapātraṃ tu niśadau cāmarastathā
ālīḍhā ca nirālīḍhā  sālīḍhālīḍhakaiḥ saha ||2/30 ||
yoginīnāṃ paraṃ sāraṃ vidhānaṃ kramaśāsanam | siddhakrameṇa āyātaṃ pāraṃparyakramāgatam
kā vidyā paramārthena siddhānāṃ tattvadarśinī | tayāvijñātamātrayā siddhasaṃtānapāragaḥ
śrībhairava uvāca pṛcchāmi paramaṃ devi svavimarśabalena tu | agragā tu parā devyā saṃhārakaraṇakṣamā
sṛṣṭicakrasya deveśa sakṛduccāraṇena vai | tasmātvaṃ devadeveśa asyoccāraṇatatparaḥ
sarvotkṛṣṭatamatve'aapi vimarśagrasanākulā | caturthīṃ laharīṃ viddhi śāṃbhavī kālabhakṣakī
tatastu  paramaṃ praśnaṃ  kathayasva tu hṛdgatam ||2/2 ||
manane trāṇane ratā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | kakalākamalārūḍhā kākacañcupuṭiśritā
pūrvādīśānakaṃ yāvad vāgbhavāntāni suvrate | karṇikāyāṃ tu vinyasya mandiraṃ bhīmavikramam
ādau tāvat mukhāmnāyaṃ svamukhacalanena ca | grāhyaṃ prāṇāntikaṃ tattvaṃ tataḥ pūjā *?ma*?bheta
ālikhet tu tṛtīyaṃ vai cakraṃ saṃhārakārakam | atyutkaṭaṃ mahādīptaṃ svaraśmiśatasaṃkulam
mattagandhakavāhasthe'aapānarūpe namo'stu te | ṣaṭcakravarjite kāli cakrānteśi namo'stu te
caturviṃśatiryāḥ (?) devi kena mantreṇa khecarāḥ | prakaṭaṃ paramārthena tad vadasva yathārthataḥ
taṃ namaṃ satupasarvaṃ? ṭhakāraṃ vartulaṃ mahat | kathitaṃ tava deveśa bhāsākhyaṃ tat viduḥ padam
kathitāstu samāsena khecakre tu yathā matāḥ  ||2/22 ||
bhargasya jñānamādāya devī sā khaṃ samāgatā | kālakālakalārūḍhā ārūḍhā rūḍhagā parā
pūjānāmāni divyāni vadāmi bhavato hara | vaktra sarvajanakhāgre karṇe tu kathayāmi te
gandharvaiḥ kinnarairdivyaiḥ sādhyaiśca  vasubhistathā ||1/ 46 ||
arūpā sarvarūpā ca mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | yā vāktraye atītā yā parārūpe khageśvarī
lakmīyugmaṃ tathā māyā mahāśabdamataḥ param | eṣā pañcākṣarī vidyā viddhi bhairava tattvataḥ
catvāraḥ sarvasāmānyāḥ niḥsvabhāvasvabhāvagāḥ | khaprāptāḥ parameśāni taṃ vadasva mamepsitam
samayāṃ pūrayed rudra bāhyato vīranāyaka | gurupaṃktiryathārthato ādau pūjyā suyatnataḥ
navamena sthitisthena lāṃcchitaṃ kuru bhairava | tṛtīyametat kathitaṃ caturthamadhunā śṛṇu
guruprasādāt prāpyaitāḥ ko narastiṣṭhate bhuvi | śrībhairava uvāca caturviṃśatiryā devyaḥ śrutā me tvatprasādataḥ
dhāmatrayasya sā kālī bhāsamānā aharniśi | aṃbhāṣā sarvato hikkā bhāṣakābhāṣakī sadā
prāptā tu paramā devyā mahāsiddhipradāstu tāḥ  ||2/19 ||
tacchṛṇuṣva samāsena sārāt sārataraṃ śubham ||2/17 ||
melāpena yathā devyo militāstu svabhāvataḥ | dvādaśa ca prayatnena viśvarūpā nirañjanāḥ
paramasiddhi ca padaṃ śuddhaśabdamataḥ param | bahuśabdaṃ tatoddhṛtya svarūpe ca padaṃ tataḥ
